title: Accounting and Tax Services for the GCC and India-GCC Groups
menuText: One team for India and the Gulf
summary: One team and one set of numbers for businesses operating in India and the Gulf.
metaTitle: GCC Accounting, VAT and Tax Services for India-GCC Groups
metaDescription: Outsourced finance for the GCC: UAE and Saudi VAT, corporate tax and Zakat, payroll, IFRS reporting and consolidated MIS for India-GCC groups.
heroHeading: One finance team on both sides of the Gulf.
heroIntro: For businesses with operations, owners or investors in India and the GCC, we run the finance function across both, so your group numbers always reconcile.
pills: Oman and Bahrain VAT on request
overview:
Cross-border groups often keep separate books, separate advisers and separate reporting calendars. We bring both sides into one monthly cycle with one set of definitions, so owners and lenders see a single picture.

There are two ways to work with us in the GCC. Direct: you hire us as your outsourced finance team. Partner: you keep the client and the relationship, and we run the back office under your brand and your service levels.
howWeServe: Indian business with GCC operations: consolidated MIS in INR and in AED or SAR, with Indian GAAP or Ind AS to IFRS reconciliation.
Gulf-based owner with an Indian business: monthly reporting in AED or SAR, with Indian GST, TDS, income tax and payroll handled for you.
Intercompany accounts, loans and recharges tracked and reconciled.
Currency translation and revaluation each month.
Data preparation for FEMA-related filings such as the annual FLA return.

highlights.title: Registrations and filings
highlights.text: Submitted through your own portal account or a licensed agent where representation is required.

highlights.title: Statutory audit
highlights.text: Performed by your licensed auditor in the country.

highlights.title: Other GCC markets
highlights.text: Oman and Bahrain VAT compliance is available on request.

highlights.title: Partner programme
highlights.text: White-label delivery for business-setup firms, corporate service providers and advisory firms.

note: Delivery runs from our India team. Registrations, representation and signatures that need local licensing are handled by you or a licensed in-country partner.

faqs.q: Which GCC countries do you cover?
faqs.a: The UAE and Saudi Arabia, with Oman and Bahrain VAT compliance available on request.

faqs.q: Do you provide reports in local currency?
faqs.a: Yes. Reports are in AED or SAR, with INR views if you also operate in India.
